title: Sub-lemma: $W$ genuinely lies in $\mathcal W(\Pi,\psi^{-1})$ and the off-mirabolic translation identities

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Claim needed.** Two bookkeeping-but-load-bearing facts:

1. **Realizability in the Whittaker model.** The test datum used (often specified by its values on the mirabolic / in the Kirillov model) must arise from a genuine $W\in\mathcal W(\Pi,\psi^{-1})$ on all of $\mathrm{GL}_{n+1}(F)$, not merely a function on the mirabolic $P_{n+1}$. Justify via the Bernstein–Zelevinsky filtration / density of mirabolic restrictions and the injectivity of restriction to $P_{n+1}$.

2. **Translation identity.** The identities relating $W(\operatorname{diag}(g,1)u_Q)$ to mirabolic Whittaker values — e.g. the off-mirabolic right-translation identity of the form
$$W(\operatorname{diag}(g,1)\,t_Q)=\psi(-g_{nn})\,W(\operatorname{diag}(g,1)\,d_Q^{-1})$$
(right-translating by the relevant element of $N_{n+1}$) — must be **proved**, using the left $N_{n+1}$-equivariance $W(ux)=\psi^{-1}(u)W(x)$ and the explicit form of $u_Q=I_{n+1}+QE_{n,n+1}$. In a previous attempt these were asserted without proof.

**To prove.** State precisely which translates of $W$ appear and verify each identity from the Whittaker equivariance and the matrix algebra of $u_Q$, $\operatorname{diag}(g,1)$.

comments.author: solver-agent
comments.body:
I rewrote the two load-bearing sub-lemmas (`lem:extend` and `lem:u1translate`) so that both facts the issue flags are now **proved**, not asserted.

**1. Realizability in the Whittaker model (Lemma, "Realizability via the Kirillov model").** The lemma now has two explicit parts:
- **(a) Injectivity of mirabolic restriction** — newly stated and justified: $W\mapsto W|_{P_{n+1}}$ is injective on $\mathcal W(\Pi,\psi^{-1})$ (Bernstein–Zelevinsky: $\Pi|_{P_{n+1}}$ is the Kirillov model, a faithful $P_{n+1}$-module). This guarantees the "$W_0$" produced is unambiguous (the issue title explicitly asked for injectivity).
- **(b) Surjectivity onto compactly supported data** — the Bernstein–Zelevinsky/Kirillov theorem (K1): every $f\in\mathcal S(N_n\backslash G_n;\psi^{-1})$ (compact support mod $N_n$) is the restriction to $\operatorname{diag}(G_n,1)$ of a genuine $W\in\mathcal W(\Pi,\psi^{-1})$ on all of $G_{n+1}$. I added the mechanism (top BZ derivative one-dimensional for generic $\Pi$; bottom filtration layer $\cong\operatorname{ind}_{N_{n+1}}^{P_{n+1}}\psi^{-1}$, whose function space is exactly $\mathcal S(N_n\backslash G_n;\psi^{-1})$), and the identification $P_{n+1}=\operatorname{diag}(G_n,1)\ltimes U$ with $\psi^{-1}|_U$ given by the $(n,n+1)$ superdiagonal entry.
- I then **verified in full** that $W_0$ from (eq:W0) qualifies: left $(N_n,\psi^{-1})$-equivariance (explicit Haar substitution), smoothness (right $K_n$-invariance), and compact support mod $N_n$ (support $=N_nK_n$, image $(N_n\cap K_n)\backslash K_n$ compact).

**2. Off-mirabolic translation identity (Lemma).** Now a 3-step proof from scratch:
- **Step 1 (matrix algebra):** with $M=\operatorname{diag}(g,1)$ and $E_{n,n+1}=e_n e_{n+1}^{\mathsf T}$, the conjugate $n_g=M u_1 M^{-1}=I+(Me_n)(e_{n+1}^{\mathsf T}M^{-1})=I+\sum_{i=1}^n g_{in}E_{i,n+1}\in N_{n+1}$, using $Me_n=\sum g_{in}e_i$ and $e_{n+1}^{\mathsf T}M^{-1}=e_{n+1}^{\mathsf T}$.
- **Step 2 (generic character):** among entries $(n_g)_{i,n+1}=g_{in}$, only $i=n$ is on the superdiagonal, so $\psi^{-1}(n_g)=\psi(-g_{nn})$.
- **Step 3 (left equivariance):** $\operatorname{diag}(g,1)u_1=n_g\operatorname{diag}(g,1)$ and $W(ux)=\psi^{-1}(u)W(x)$ give $W(\operatorname{diag}(g,1)u_1 h)=\psi(-g_{nn})W(\operatorname{diag}(g,1)h)$ for **all** $h\in G_{n+1}$.
- The consequence $W_0(g\,t_Q)=\psi(-g_{nn})W_0(g\,d_Q^{-1})$ is then derived with $h=d_Q^{-1}$, after verifying $t_Q=u_1 d_Q^{-1}=d_Q^{-1}u_Q$ entrywise (unique nonzero off-diagonal entry $1$ at $(n,n+1)$).

**Numerical verification.** I confirmed by direct matrix computation (n=3) that $n_g=\operatorname{diag}(g,1)u_1\operatorname{diag}(g,1)^{-1}=I+\sum_i g_{in}E_{i,n+1}$ with superdiagonal entry $g_{nn}$, and that $u_1 d_Q^{-1}=d_Q^{-1}u_Q$ with $(n,n+1)$-entry $1$.

Environment/brace balance checked; LaTeX toolchain not installed so no compile, but `enumitem` (used for the (a)/(b) list) is in the shared preamble.

Both items requested are now proved with explicit matrix algebra and Whittaker-equivariance; resolving.
